The file ceiling is the lowest metric band.
boundaries: C# cognitive complexity is not measured by any available tool and is reported null.

score.level_basis: Gate 5 measurement with the rubric's band table, an AST nesting measure for Python, a conservative brace estimate for C# (so no false zero), and declared null for unmeasured metrics.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: inputs are admitted by strict Pydantic models before use (RULE_PY_001) and outputs are typed; behaviour matches the documented contract in the module docstring and README. Band boundaries follow the SCORING.md table and are tested at every edge.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Every band edge, elif handling, inner scopes, brace masking and the report command are tested. Mutation R = 53/54 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 7, cognitive 8, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
